usedFor: Dubble holds your guides, and Asana receives follow-up work when “Guide Added to a Collection” runs “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “Guide Added to a Collection” in Dubble, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Adding a guide to a collection can create a task with an assignee and dates set right then.

watchOut: “Create Task or Subtask” makes a new task each time, so a guide moved between collections can add several.
